def get(self, key, default=None):
        p = self._path(key)
        if not os.path.exists(p):
            return default
        with open(p) as f:
            rec = json.load(f)

        # The timestamp is recorded when the value is written, rather than
        # relying on the file's mtime.  This also keeps expiration predictable
        # for callers that provide a clock (for example, in tests).
        if self._now() - rec["t"] > self.ttl:
            os.remove(p)
            return default
        return rec["v"]
